# Overview

This file performs the County Durham within-area analysis using the same 0-3 low-accessibility measure as Phase 1.

## 1. Setup and extraction

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

lsoa_map <- readRDS("data/processed/lsoa_map.rds")
un1_analytic <- readRDS("data/processed/un1_analytic.rds")
un1_uf1_analytic <- readRDS("data/processed/un1_uf1_analytic.rds")
selected_case_las <- readRDS("data/processed/selected_case_las.rds")

if (length(selected_case_las) != 1 || selected_case_las != "County Durham") {
  stop("The selected case must be County Durham. Re-run the final Phase 1 file.")
}

summarise_dose_response <- function(data, group_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_inactivity = mean(inactive_rate),
      median_inactivity = median(inactive_rate),
      sd_inactivity = sd(inactive_rate),
      se = sd_inactivity / sqrt(n),
      t_critical = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_lower = mean_inactivity - t_critical * se,
      ci_upper = mean_inactivity + t_critical * se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

case_data <- un1_analytic %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las)

case_attributes <- case_data %>%
  rename(LSOA21CD = lsoa21_code)

case_map <- lsoa_map %>%
  select(LSOA21CD, geometry) %>%
  inner_join(case_attributes, by = "LSOA21CD") %>%
  st_make_valid()

county_durham_codes <- imd_2021 %>%
  filter(la_name_lookup == selected_case_las) %>%
  pull(lsoa21cd)

case_boundary <- lsoa_sf %>%
  filter(LSOA21CD %in% county_durham_codes) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
  st_make_valid()

stopifnot(
  nrow(case_data) > 0,
  nrow(case_map) == nrow(case_data),
  n_distinct(case_map$LSOA21CD) == nrow(case_map),
  !st_is_empty(case_boundary)
)

cat("Selected case:", selected_case_las, "\n")
cat("UN1 complete-case LSOAs:", nrow(case_data), "\n")
```

## 2. Internal distribution

```{r internal-distribution}
case_internal_distribution <- case_data %>%
  count(n_low_access_dimensions, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

print(case_internal_distribution)

case_dimension_combinations <- case_data %>%
  count(
    low_employment_accessibility,
    low_gp_accessibility,
    low_supermarket_accessibility,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

print(case_dimension_combinations)
```

## 3. County Durham maps

```{r map-dimensions}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = case_boundary,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = case_map,
    aes(fill = n_low_access_dimensions),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "plasma",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Low-accessibility\ndimensions",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Low-accessibility Dimensions in County Durham",
    subtitle = "Coloured areas are UN1 complete-case LSOAs; grey areas are outside the main sample"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  "data/processed/county_durham_low_access_dimensions.png",
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r map-inactivity}
ggplot() +
```

## 4. Main within-case analysis

```{r main-dose-response}
case_dose_response <- summarise_dose_response(
  case_data,
  n_low_access_dimensions
)

print(case_dose_response)
```

```{r main-dose-response-plot}

p_main <- ggplot(
  case_data,
  aes(
    x = n_low_access_dimensions,
    y = inactive_rate,
    fill = n_low_access_dimensions
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.size = 1.2,
    outlier.shape = 16
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "plasma",
    direction = -1,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Economic Inactivity by Number of Low-Accessibility Dimensions",
    subtitle = "County Durham, UN1 complete-case LSOAs",
    x = "Number of low-accessibility dimensions",
    y = "Economic inactivity rate",
    caption = paste0(
    "Boxplot guide:  — Median    □ Middle 50% of values\n",
    "| Whiskers: values within 1.5 × IQR    ● Outliers: values beyond 1.5 × IQR"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      size = 10,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    )
  )

p_main

ggsave(
  "data/processed/county_durham_dose_response_boxplot.png",
  plot = p_main,
  width = 10,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```


### National vs County Durham trend comparison

```{r national-county-durham-comparison}

# National mean economic inactivity for each low-accessibility count
national_dose_response <- summarise_dose_response(
  un1_analytic,
  n_low_access_dimensions
)

# Combine national and County Durham summaries
trend_comparison <- bind_rows(
  national_dose_response %>%
    mutate(area = "National UN1 sample"),
  
  case_dose_response %>%
    mutate(area = "County Durham")
) %>%
  mutate(
    n_dimensions = as.numeric(as.character(n_low_access_dimensions))
  )

print(trend_comparison)

# Plot
ggplot(
  trend_comparison,
  aes(
    x = n_dimensions,
    y = mean_inactivity,
    group = area,
    linetype = area,
    shape = area
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(mean_inactivity, accuracy = 0.01)),
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0.35, 0.52)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Economic Inactivity by Number of Low-accessibility Dimensions",
    subtitle = "Urban England and County Durham, UN1 complete-case LSOAs",
    x = "Number of low-accessibility dimensions",
    y = "Mean economic inactivity rate",
    linetype = NULL,
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  "data/processed/national_county_durham_trend_comparison.png",
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r main-models}
case_trend_model <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~ n_low_access_dimensions_num,
  data = case_data
)

case_adjusted_data <- case_data %>%
  drop_na(deprivation_score)

case_adjusted_model <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~ n_low_access_dimensions_num + deprivation_score,
  data = case_adjusted_data
)

cat("Unadjusted model n:", nobs(case_trend_model), "\n")
print(summary(case_trend_model))

cat("\nDeprivation-adjusted model n:", nobs(case_adjusted_model), "\n")
print(summary(case_adjusted_model))
```

## 5. UN1 + UF1 sensitivity analysis

```{r sensitivity-data}
case_data_sens <- un1_uf1_analytic %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las)

stopifnot(nrow(case_data_sens) > 0)

case_dose_response_sens <- summarise_dose_response(
  case_data_sens,
  n_low_access_dimensions_sens
)

print(case_dose_response_sens)
```

```{r sensitivity-models}
case_trend_model_sens <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~ n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num,
  data = case_data_sens
)

case_adjusted_data_sens <- case_data_sens %>%
  drop_na(deprivation_score)

case_adjusted_model_sens <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~
    n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num +
    deprivation_score,
  data = case_adjusted_data_sens
)

cat("Sensitivity unadjusted model n:", nobs(case_trend_model_sens), "\n")
print(summary(case_trend_model_sens))

cat("\nSensitivity adjusted model n:", nobs(case_adjusted_model_sens), "\n")
print(summary(case_adjusted_model_sens))
```

```{r sensitivity-plot}
ggplot(
  case_data_sens,
  aes(
    x = n_low_access_dimensions_sens,
    y = inactive_rate,
    fill = n_low_access_dimensions_sens
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.size = 0.7,
    width = 0.75
  ) +

  # Mean
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = function(y) {
      m <- mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      data.frame(
        y = m,
        ymin = m,
        ymax = m
      )
    },
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.74,
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity Analysis: Economic Inactivity by Low-accessibility Dimensions",
    subtitle = "County Durham, UN1 + UF1 complete-case LSOAs",
    x = "Number of low-accessibility dimensions",
    y = "Economic inactivity rate",
    caption = paste0(
      "Boxplot guide: black line = median; red line = mean; box = middle 50% of values\n",
      "Whiskers = values within 1.5 × IQR; points = values beyond 1.5 × IQR"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  "data/processed/county_durham_sensitivity_boxplot.png",
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
case_student_summary <- case_data %>%
  group_by(n_low_access_dimensions) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_student_rate = mean(inactive_student_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_student_rate = median(inactive_student_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_student_share = mean(student_share_of_inactive, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_student_share = median(student_share_of_inactive, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(case_student_summary)

case_data <- case_data %>%
  mutate(
    nonstudent_inactive_rate =
      inactive_rate - inactive_student_rate
  )

case_inactivity_decomposition <- case_data %>%
  group_by(n_low_access_dimensions) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_total_inactivity =
      mean(inactive_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_student_inactivity =
      mean(inactive_student_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_nonstudent_inactivity =
      mean(nonstudent_inactive_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(case_inactivity_decomposition)

case_comparison_plot <- case_inactivity_decomposition %>%
  transmute(
    n_low_access_dimensions,
    `Total economic inactivity` = mean_total_inactivity,
    `Inactivity excluding student component` = mean_nonstudent_inactivity
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -n_low_access_dimensions,
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "rate"
  )

p_composition <- ggplot(
  case_comparison_plot,
  aes(
    x = as.numeric(as.character(n_low_access_dimensions)),
    y = rate,
    group = measure,
    linetype = measure,
    shape = measure
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = -0.8,
    size = 3.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0.33, 0.54)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Economic Inactivity Before and After Removing the Student Component",
    subtitle = "County Durham, UN1 complete-case LSOAs",
    x = "Number of low-accessibility dimensions",
    y = "Mean economic inactivity rate",
    linetype = NULL,
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_composition

ggsave(
  "data/processed/county_durham_student_composition_line.png",
  p_composition,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
